catalog-api.response-cache:
Approved catalog-api response-cache agreement (CACHE-18 v2)

Applies to response caching shared across catalog-api readers, including future readers.

```json
{
  "project": "catalog-api",
  "cache": {
    "ttl_seconds": 300,
    "max_entries": 3,
    "eviction_policy": "fifo",
    "namespace": "catalog-response",
    "cache_misses": true
  }
}
```

SOURCE: Operations approval CACHE-18 (2026-09-06), version v2

RATIONALE: Reduce stale catalog responses while retaining the other approved cache settings.
